Tumour risk in this entry varies so widely by antibody that no single route can be claimed across the syndrome. Graded below the checkpoint inhibitor link into this same node because that one has a sentence naming autoimmunity, while this one has a screening recommendation and a timing statistic.

Viral destruction of neurons releases synaptic antigen into a compartment the immune system can reach, and a GluN1-directed IgG response follows in a minority of survivors. Pointed at the NMDAR node rather than the general autoimmunity node because the association is specific to that antibody, which the entry's own evidence explanation already says.

Releasing the checkpoint brakes on T cells lifts them against self antigens as well as tumour ones, which is the same adaptive-resistance machinery the immune_checkpoint_blockade module models from the tumour's side. Loss of peripheral tolerance is the intervening step. Recorded as predisposing rather than triggering because most treated patients never develop it.
